usageNotes: Use this endpoint to get a cluster-wide snapshot of firewall enablement and rule counts across all nodes and guests on a PDM-managed PVE remote. The response is hierarchical: top-level cluster status, per-node status, and per-guest (LXC or QEMU) status — each with enabled flag, total rule count (all), and active rule count (active). Requires Resource.Audit on the remote; the remote must already be registered in PDM and reachable.

examples.summary: Check firewall status across all nodes and guests on the 'prod-cluster' remote

tips: The 'status' field is optional on nodes and guests — a missing status object typically means the firewall module returned no data for that resource (e.g. node offline or guest stopped).
Compare 'active' vs 'all' rule counts to identify resources where rules exist but the firewall is disabled (enabled: false) or rules are partially inactive.
Guest 'kind' distinguishes LXC containers from QEMU VMs — useful when filtering results by workload type.
This is a read-only audit call; no changes are made to firewall state.
